dps_shared.translation: If thought processes were yourself, monks, then thought processes would/could not lead to affliction, this could be obtained from (lit. in) mental processes, "May my mental processes be like this, may my mental processes not be like this."
dps_shared.example: saṅkhārā ca h'idaṃ, bhikkhave, attā abhavissaṃsu, na'y'idaṃ saṅkhārā ābādhāya saṃvatteyyuṃ, labbhetha ca saṅkhāresu, evaṃ me saṅkhārā hontu, evaṃ me saṅkhārā mā ahesun'ti.
